about: What Antigravity's CLI may do when Aico calls it with `agy -p`. Print mode leaves its file tools on (seen live with agy 1.5.3: it read and wrote files outside its folder), so every call denies them. A call without a schema also names an agent with no tools. A call with --json-schema can't: seen live, a custom agent loses structured_output and loops looking for a finish tool, so it keeps search_web, which no deny rule stops. Permission names are agy's own: read_file(path), write_file(path), command(prefix), mcp(server/tool), read_url(domain), execute_url(domain).

answer_agent.name: aico-answer
answer_agent.description: Answers from the text it is given, with no tools.
answer_agent.body: Answer from the text you are given. You have no tools.
